title: Rubies
content:
*The rubies in the eyes of the viper of the [[Traitors' Pit]] were prised from the eyes of an idol in the Black Ziggurat ([[18.26]])
*[[Giles Chosard]] ([[09.06]]) took seemingly identical rubies from the Green Ziggurat ([[06.10]]) and gave them to [[Ilace]] ([[03.08]].01).
